records.name: Dignity Philadelphia
records.summary: A Catholic community for LGBTQ+ Catholics. Members gather for Sunday Mass in Center City, join online Masses and discussion nights, and get a newsletter about upcoming events.
records.what_you_do: Come to Mass in person or online, join a Zoom discussion, or read the group's quarterly magazine. Members also get invitations to events.

schedule.text: Mass in person on Sundays at 7 pm, plus some online Masses and discussion nights on Zoom. Check the services page for dates.

locations.label: The Church of St. Luke and the Epiphany (Sunday Mass)

cost.text: Not stated on the pages we read

first_step.how: Come to Sunday Mass at 7 pm at St. Luke and the Epiphany, or join an online Mass on Zoom. Email hello@dignityphila.org to ask how to get on the newsletter list.
first_step.basis: Mass times, a meeting place and a public contact email are published, and the group posts its events publicly.

records.notes: Sunday Mass in person at 7 pm at St. Luke and the Epiphany, 330 S 13th Street, per the services page. The services page lists online Masses on Oct 11, 2026 and later dates. The home page lists a Zoom discussion dated Sept 29, 2026 and OurFest 2026 (Oct 9 to 11) where the group tables. Cost is unknown: the membership page was not read. Interests are the closest tags; no tag covers a Catholic LGBTQ+ congregation. Kind set to congregation.

records.name: Philadelphia Fins Aquatics Club
records.summary: A swim club that welcomes swimmers of every age and skill level. It practices at a pool in Center City on weeknight evenings and weekend mornings.
records.what_you_do: Swim at the scheduled practices, which are open to swimmers at every level. Join the team as a member to train with it.

schedule.text: Practices Monday to Thursday, 7:30 to 8:45 pm, and Saturday and Sunday, 10:30 am to noon, as listed on the USMS club page. Confirm before you come.

cost.text: Not stated on the pages we could read

first_step.how: Contact the club through its website, philadelphiafins.org, and ask how to join a practice. The practice times are published on the USMS club page.
first_step.basis: Practice times and a welcome statement are published, but the join steps and any registration requirement could not be read on the club's own site.

records.notes: The club's own site returned HTTP 403 on every path tried, so nothing here comes from the club itself. The USMS club page is undated and is the only verified source. No dated sign of life was verified, so status is unknown. The batch name was Fins Aquatics Club; the public name is Philadelphia Fins Aquatics Club. Unverified search snippets, not used in any field: an 18 or older rule, a 2024 meet listing (the USMS results page returned 403), a $20 drop-in in summer 2025, and summer weekends moving to an outdoor pool. Older coverage gave other addresses (16th and Race, and a 17th Street location); the USMS address is used. The phillygaycalendar directory listing shows only 2011 and 2013 posts. A ProPublica record named Fins Swim Club Inc (org 721515022) is a different filer number and was not matched to this EIN.

notes: Searches: 2 of 2 used, both on Fins Aquatics Club and Earths Keepers, which were the joinable or blocked groups most worth a look. That left no search for Doctors Advisory Alliance, Family Inc, Fans Helping Fans, E Volve, Factsonisrael.com, Electric Education and Fight for Cure, which are written as unknown. Fetches: 32, including retries and two early guesses at domains that are not in the batch (diabolique.org and diabolique.ball). Both failed and were not used. Errors were mostly DNS failures, TLS or connection failures, and 403 blocks spread across many hosts. That looked like network trouble more than rate limiting, so each failing host got one retry and Electric Education got three tries. No 403 was bypassed. The evolvefoundation.net link redirected to evolve.org, which is not the same organization. Earths Keepers' batch liveness field (alive, HTTP 200, checked 13:18 UTC today) conflicts with this run (403). Leads not followed: the Church of St. Luke and the Epiphany, which hosts Dignity's Sunday Mass (no site was read), and the ProPublica filer for Fins Swim Club Inc (org 721515022), which has a different filer number. Counts: 10 publish (1 active, 9 unknown), 4 hide, 1 out_of_area.
